item.description:
Theme Squeeze 0.2.5

  • A calmer left-to-right workflow for adding media, choosing a file-size goal, and exporting.
  • Smallest file is now the default and clearly identifies high compression; balanced and highest-quality choices explain their tradeoffs.
  • Comparison, detailed asset controls, and advanced export options stay available without crowding the main flow.
  • Added a light and dark appearance control with adaptive native materials.
